title: Eval final answer
description: The one structured final answer an agent gives in both arms of the pre-registered eval (EVL-02, D-02). Passed to `claude -p` as --json-schema. Hashed into the pre-registration; a change after the freeze needs a new registered run.

answer.description: `found` when the agent located what the question asks for, `not_found` when it concluded there is nothing to find.

items.description: The places that answer the question. Empty for `not_found`.

file.description: Path of the file, relative to the repository root.

symbol.description: Name of the function, class or method the item is about.

summary.description: One short sentence of explanation; at most 400 characters.
